title: Luchuan–Pingmian campaigns
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Luchuan–Pingmian campaigns", at revision 1370627163, opens: "The Luchuan–Pingmian campaigns (1436–49) were punitive expeditions carried out by the Ming dynasty under the rule of the Emperor Yingzong against the Shan-led State of Möng Mao near the frontier with the Kingdom of Ava." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q3702778, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "Military conflict". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
